_comment: iOS 4.1 (8B117) overlay on rootfs/recipe.json. Applied by scripts/versions.py into build/fw-4.1/recipe.json; the base recipe is never changed. Cydia/TLSFix use the base recipe's package set (Cydia 1.1.30 and Substrate run on iOS >= 2.0/3.x); only the 4.2.1 IconState layout is dropped.
_new_hex_replace: relocate the literal CFStrings in liblockdown's activation table: ProductVersion 4.2.1 -> 4.1 (length 5 -> 3, keeping the 160-byte patch), BuildVersion 8C148 -> 8B117 (same length)
_file_patch_offsets_by_base: Keys are 8C148 dyld-cache offsets in rootfs/recipe.json; values are 8B117 offsets relocated by dyld-cache symbol+offset (see docs/multi-version.md). Keying by the base offset makes the map independent of patches inserted into the base recipe; null entries are skipped.

extra_file_patches.why: 8B117 liblockdown: stub lockdown_copy_value as on 8C148 (key table lookup; else NULL). SpringBoard calls this during activation, and the unpatched body dereferences NULL +4 in a crash loop (58 GL contexts, no home screen). Keys are the 8B117 addresses of the CFStringRef arrays (0x3e0812xx/33x), values the 8B117 'Activated', kCFBooleanFalse and 'iPod' literals plus inline strings at 0x304f9650.

8B117 lockdown_copy_value key/value table in a zero-filled gap of liblockdown (VA 0x304f9650): ActivationState/BrickState/DeviceClass/DeviceName/ProductType/ProductVersion/BuildVersion/HardwareModel, with 4.1/8B117/N72AP literals (same layout as the 8C148 table).

8B117 MusicLibrary MLSSqliteVFSOpen (0x30570718), the 4.1 form of 8C148's _AOU243378_7_1 patch (which 8B117 does not have; the check is inlined): bne at 0x305708c4 jumps to the branch that sets the file's '<db>.cbk' path (+20) and has-checksum flag (+24) when the name is in AOU243378_5's signed-file set. -> nop: every library file opens as a plain sqlite file, so the library scripts/music.py builds (unsigned) opens in the iPod app.

8B117 CoreMotion CLPlatformInfo::getProviders (VA 0x3053bbcc, cache offset 0x53bbcc): the N45/N72 hardware cases both branch to 0x3053bc38, where 'mov r2,#0x12' (provider mask without gyro) is stored to the cached provider. 8C148's single 0x2012 -> 0x2052 literal (recipe offset 0x3224dd4) became an immediate in 8B117; 0x52 is 8B117's N81 mask at 0x3053bc58 (gyro bit 6 set, as verified by getSystemHardware's model table). Without it CMMotionManager.gyroAvailable stays NO even with the HID gyro service (docs/mcu.md section 11).

8B117 CLPlatformInfo::getProviders' N18 case (shares the N72 provider set on 8C148) has its own copy of the 'mov r2,#0x12' immediate at VA 0x3053bc4c; patch it to 0x52 together with the N45/N72 site so every model sharing the N72 mask reports a gyro capability.

_extra_file_patches: Patches absent from the 4.2.1 recipe: the base recipe's lockdown_copy_value body and table changed too much to relocate (§5.2), so the equivalent 8B117 stub/table is spelled out here with verified original bytes.
_cydia_plist_write: The base IconState.plist is SpringBoard's 4.2.1 layout (Game Center etc.); 4.1 keeps its own first-boot layout, so Cydia lands on page 2
_cydia_pseudo: Cydia's virtual firmware packages with 8B117's values (CoreFoundation 550.38.1, Darwin 10.3.1)
